page_title: AI App Builder: Build Your Own App Without Coding

sources.entry: EveryApp - AI app builder that turns a plain-language description into your own private web app at its own address, shared with the people you invite. #freemium #nocode

summary.name: EveryApp AI App Builder
summary.one_liner: An AI app builder that turns a plain-language description into a private web app with its own address, shared only with people you invite, and installable from the browser.
use_cases: Build a family chore chart or calendar
Track rent, bills or money owed to friends
Make a habit or workout tracker
Create a quiz or flashcard game for a class
Build a simple order or booking log for a small business
Set up a pet or plant care log with reminders
summary.what_it_does: The App Builder takes a description written in everyday words, asks a question or two, and generates an app with its own web address. Each version previews as soon as it is ready, and you can ask for changes or return to any earlier version. The page says EveryApp hosts and maintains the apps and that you can download your app and its data at any time. Apps can be installed on a phone or computer from the browser and work offline. Access is limited to you and invited people, who sign in with their own EveryApp accounts. The page also lists EveryApp's ready-made free apps, including Expense Split, Habit Tracker, To-Do List, Meal Planner and Chore Chart.
notable: Describe an app in plain words and get a hosted app with its own address
Installs from the browser to phone or computer and works offline
Shared access with invited people, who sign in with their own EveryApp accounts
Free ready-made apps (expense splitting, habit tracker, to-do list, meal planner, chore chart) are also offered
caveats: Included with EveryApp Pro; building and changing apps uses a monthly allowance, with top-ups available
Cannot publish apps for the public, take payments, run custom server code or connect to other accounts such as bank or email
Apps are not listed in the App Store or Google Play; AI output can contain mistakes and the user is responsible for testing it
